text: Anyone got lunch recs near the office? I’m tired of the same old sandwiches. Craving something spicy tbh.
Try Tikka Town on 17th! Their chicken tikka wrap is 🔥. Also, did anyone catch the Nuggets game last night? That 3rd quarter was wild.
Omg yes, Jokic was on another level. Also, has anyone seen the warehouse cat today? I swear she was sleeping on top of the label printer again 😂
Haha, she knocked over my coffee this morning. Cat’s got attitude. And +1 for Tikka Town, but if you want tacos, El Camino’s lunch special is solid too.
